heroHeadline: Grand Egyptian Museum Opens; Sisi Deploys Jets to UAE Amid Iran Crisis
heroSubtitle: Egypt marks a cultural milestone as the $1 billion Grand Egyptian Museum opens fully near Giza — while President Sisi navigates the Iran-Israel-Gulf conflict by deploying Rafale fighters to the UAE, deepening Egypt's Sudan war role, and steering an economy where inflation has fallen to 14% and reserves hit a record $53 billion.
footerNote: Data sourced from Egyptian official records, UNESCO, academic Egyptology research (Shaw, Lehner, Hawass), major international outlets, IMF, Human Rights Watch, and institutional analyses.
